list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete S-shaped tetrameric polyoxoanion comprises two dimethyltin-decorated Er-containing units built from pentavacant B-α-TeW7O28 and monovacant Lindqvist W5O18 fragments. The units are joined through a dinuclear {Er2(OH)2} core; four Er centers occur in the polyoxoanion.

synthesis.procedure: Add sodium tungstate dihydrate, potassium tellurite, dimethyltin dichloride and dimethylamine hydrochloride successively to water with vigorous stirring. Adjust pH with 6 mol L−1 HCl, stir about 10 min, add erbium nitrate hexahydrate, maintain pH with 0.5 mol L−1 HCl, stir another 30 min and filter.

reagents.amount: 6 mol L−1 and 0.5 mol L−1 solutions; volumes not reported
reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid

synthesis.time: About 10 min before Er addition; another 30 min stirring; approximately 3 weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Aqueous one-pot reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter; slowly evaporate the filtrate at ambient temperature to obtain pink prism crystals.
